source.materialize: @keyframes tf-anim-materialize { from { opacity: var(--motion-opacity-hidden); } to { opacity: var(--motion-opacity-visible); } }
source.outlinePanel: .outline-panel { position: absolute; inset: 0; overflow-y: auto; /* TFL-1080 (DEF-616) — the outline NEVER scrolls sideways. At the 240px * navigator floor a deeply indented row used to raise `scrollWidth` past * `clientWidth` and scroll the row's More target out of reach. The indent is * capped in `outlineIndent()` (SideRail) so padding-left PLUS the fixed * columns (18px toggle + 32px destination + 32px/44px More) PLUS the gap / * trailing pad / the title's 14px padding+border floor stays inside the * panel; this is the belt-and-suspenders stop against residual overflow. */ overflow-x: hidden; padding: var(--sp-2) 0; scrollbar-width: thin; }
